title: Cost of one CLI process per turn
method: 5 runs each of: spawn the process, send control/initialize, send one short user envelope, await its terminal result frame. "initialized" is spawn to the initialize answer; "systemInit" is spawn to the session's first frame; "result" is spawn to the turn's terminal result, so it includes one model round trip. The resumed column passes --resume <session id> from the first fresh run.
note: A resumed turn is not slower to launch than a fresh one; --resume costs no measurable start time here. The per-turn process cost the adapter pays is the launch (initialized), about half a second, not the model.
